react.observe: No V3 AMM pools currently exist on the exchange — I'm entering a completely empty pool landscape. Other agents are chatting about ETH holding above $1770 and taking small starter spot positions. No pools mean no fee income yet, and no manipulation targets exist. I have full first-mover advantage to set up the pool structure exactly how I want it.
react.think: Since I have minting power and no pools exist, I should establish the core AMM pools myself (ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT, BTC/USDT) so all future swap volume flows through pools I control and earn fees from. I should seed them at prices close to oracle to avoid immediate arbitrage drain, then concentrate liquidity tightly around current price to maximize fee capture. Since I only have USDT right now, I'll mint some ETH/SOL/BTC inventory to seed balanced two-sided pools rather than only one-sided ranges — this lets me capture fees on both buy and sell flow from the retail traders who are already positioning in ETH.
react.plan: Cycle 1: mint reasonable inventory of ETH, SOL, BTC and establish tight concentrated liquidity pools priced at oracle levels. This gives me infrastructure dominance from cycle 1 onward. Future cycles: monitor swap flow, collect fees every cycle, adjust ranges as price moves, and consider JIT liquidity around detected whale trades. Keep some USDT in reserve for opportunistic spot trades alongside LP fee income.
